svg.title: boxd Sandbox: your agent's commands run in a boxd cloud machine
svg.desc: The model calls Coder, Shell or FileSystem tools such as run_command and edit_file. BoxdSandbox's get_workspace hook gives the run a boxd cloud machine as ctx.workspace, so each command and file operation goes over the boxd API, authenticated with BOXD_API_KEY, and runs in the machine as the boxd user; output comes back to the tool. The first use creates the machine, its WorkspaceRef is saved in the message history and on the result, a later run reattaches with it, and destroy(ref) deletes it. fork(ref) copies a machine, with its files and running processes, into a new isolated one.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
